display.purpose: Screen and section titles only, once per screen.

body.purpose: Default reading text, list content, field values.

subtitle.purpose: Secondary descriptive text under a title.

eyebrow.purpose: Section kickers, field labels, badge text (structural, not decorative).

stat.purpose: The single large number on a StatCard.

motion.name: pressed-opacity
motion.purpose: Pressable feedback on press, no scale or shadow change.

motion.name: disabled-opacity
motion.purpose: Disabled state for buttons and controls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The only inverted (dark-on-amber) button; used for the single primary action in a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #F5B731; background: #F5B731; color: #171310; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; transition: opacity 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F5B731; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.72; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #2C2C30; background: #18181B; color: #E8E8EC; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; transition: opacity 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #4A4A50; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F5B731; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { opacity: 0.72; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Bordered pill: tone fill + tone border + dot + Eyebrow label. Never rendered without the label.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 24px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(70,167,88,0.44); background: rgba(70,167,88,0.14); color: #46A758; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: #46A758; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The single card treatment used across the app: flat, bordered, tonal — never nested.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid #2C2C30; background: #18181B; border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; } .ds-card-eyebrow { display: block; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9898A4; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; color: #E8E8EC; margin: 0; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field: Panel Raised background, hairline border, amber selection.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 44px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid #2C2C30; background: #222225; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 12px; color: #E8E8EC; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64646E; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #F5B731; }

components.name: Bottom Nav Item
components.description: Primary navigation item: amber icon + label when active, tertiary grey when inactive.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; flex: 1; min-height: 54px; background: transparent; border: none; } .ds-nav-item span { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 9px; color: #64646E; } .ds-nav-item-active span { color: #E8E8EC; }

narrative.overview:
Vortex reads like a broadcast operations desk, not a consumer app: a near-black panel (#111113), one amber signal color, and a status vocabulary that has to survive being read at a glance, in a rush, under bad light. Everything is built to state a fact — a booking status, a payment state, a crew assignment — without decorating it. The interface stays out of the way of the job.

The system explicitly rejects enterprise-ERP dread (no dense grey forms, no cryptic field codes burying the one thing someone needs to confirm), consumer-app playfulness (no mascots, confetti, or gamified streaks — this is a crew with a deadline), and the generic SaaS dashboard (no gradient hero-metric tile, no identical icon-plus-heading card grid). Depth comes from tone and hairline borders, never shadow; motion is a state change, not a performance.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground with a three-step tonal surface ramp, no shadows anywhere
A single amber accent (#F5B731) that only ever means 'this needs you'
A ten-value status color system that must carry meaning through label + dot, never color alone
Fraunces serif reserved for section titles only; DM Sans and Menlo carry everything else
Flat, bordered surfaces; component vocabulary repeats identically across all six role workspaces

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber means "this needs you" — selection, primary action, current step. It never decorates a static element; if amber is on screen, something is asking for input or marking where you are.

rules.name: The Color-Is-Never-Alone Rule
rules.body: No status may be communicated by hue alone. StatusBadge always pairs color with the status label text and a dot; StatusStepper pairs color with a checkmark or step number.

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: Fraunces appears exactly once per screen context: the screen or section title. Buttons, badges, data, and body copy are never set in Fraunces.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. A new component signals "raised" by moving one step up the tonal ramp and adding a border, never by adding shadow.

dos: Do keep the accent to Signal Amber only. One accent, used only for primary action, selection, and current-state signals.
Do pair every status color with a label and a dot or icon.
Do keep every touch target at 44×44 minimum.
Do hold body and label text at foreground or text2, reserving text3 for large text or icon-paired hints only.
Do build new depth with the tonal surface ramp plus a hairline border, never a shadow.
Do set section and screen titles in Fraunces once per screen; everything else in DM Sans or Menlo.
donts: Don't add a second accent color or let amber decorate a static, non-actionable element.
Don't use border-left/border-right as a colored accent stripe on cards or list items.
Don't introduce card grids of identical icon+heading+text tiles or a gradient hero-metric stat block.
Don't add mascots, confetti, streaks, or other gamified/playful motifs.
Don't build dense multi-field forms or cryptic field codes that bury the one thing a user needs to confirm.
Don't add box-shadow, blur, or glass treatments anywhere.
Don't set buttons, badges, or data values in Fraunces.
Don't drop new copy into text3 below 18px/bold-14px without an icon or weight backing it up.
